scripts.test: bun test test/config-and-model.test.ts test/integrations.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts test/simulation.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test test/e2e.test.ts --timeout 30000
scripts.test:soak: bun run build && TMUX_AUTONAME_RUN_SOAK=1 TMUX_AUTONAME_SOAK_MS=1800000 bun test test/soak.test.ts --timeout 1900000
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:e2e && bun run shellcheck
